title: List rows use Item and Button is for actions
context: Full-width `wide` buttons stood in for user-menu rows, setting rows, selectable pickers and a form-field trigger. HIG models these as list rows, not buttons.
decision: A tappable list row is an Item rendered `asChild` over a `button` or link. Item base has `min-h-11` so every Item row meets 44px, and `default` and `lg` differ only in padding. A selectable row uses Item `primary` when selected and exposes `aria-pressed`. Button is for actions only.

alternatives.reason: It makes a row look like an action and duplicates what Item already provides.
Item already covers scannable rows, so a new component would duplicate it.

consequences: The `wide` callers and the team switcher options migrate to Item before `wide` is deleted.
Interactive Item rows meet the 44px touch target by default.
revisitTriggers: A row needs behaviour Item cannot express.
